description:
Download the artifact 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' from the 'example-repo-local' repository in JFrog Artifactory. 

1. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 with default credentials (admin / password).
2. Navigate to the Artifacts browser / Repository Browser.
3. Browse to 'example-repo-local' > 'org' > 'apache' > 'commons' > 'commons-lang3' > '3.14.0'.
4. Select 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' and download it.
5. Ensure the file is saved to '/home/ga/Downloads/commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar'.

You may use the 'Download' button in the UI or copy the direct link and use a terminal command (wget/curl).
